requirements.text: Patients should be able to log in to view and book available appointment times.
There needs to be a way for patients to submit repeat prescription requests online, with a verification process for eligibility.
Test results should be available online only after a clinician has reviewed them, with a way for patients to reach out for clarification if needed.
There should be a mechanism for patients to contact the clinic directly if they encounter issues or have questions about appointments, prescriptions, or test results.
The portal must prioritize security and privacy to protect patient data and maintain trust.
